_comment: Response fields present in the Ballerina entity-service but not decoded anywhere in this service. Every entry needs a reason. parity_test.go fails on an unlisted gap AND on a stale entry that has since been implemented, so this file cannot rot.

gaps.abbreviation: Tracked: digiops-cs#2811. On ReferenceTableItem; the portal's TypeScript declares it, so this is a real gap awaiting implementation.
gaps.categories: Tracked: digiops-cs#2811. On ChangeRequestMetadataResponse; the portal's TypeScript declares it.
gaps.choices: Tracked: digiops-cs#2811. On CatalogItemVariable, alongside `text` on CatalogVariableChoice.
gaps.text: Tracked: digiops-cs#2811. On CatalogVariableChoice. The name also occurs in unrelated portal types, so the 7 frontend matches are not all this field.
gaps.impacts: Not decoded from a single ServiceNow field. Declared on the domain view and assembled in the service layer from other sources, so it is absent from the sn_* decode structs by design.
gaps.priorities: Not decoded from a single ServiceNow field. Assembled in the service layer, same as impacts.
gaps.teams: Not decoded from a single ServiceNow field. Assembled in the service layer, same as impacts.
gaps.fixEta: Deliberate, do not implement. CSM-internal. backend-v2's CLAUDE.md documents the fix-ETA quartet as intentionally trimmed from customer-facing DTOs; it must never reach the portal. Could be decoded here for other consumers, but only with that trimming still enforced downstream.
gaps.alreadyAcknowledged: No consumer. On CaseUpdateResponse; no portal type declares it.
gaps.inlineImageCount: No consumer. On CommentCreateResponse; the portal reads hasInlineAttachments/inlineAttachments instead, which are implemented.
gaps.deletedBy: No consumer. On delete responses; no portal type declares it.
gaps.deletedOn: No consumer. On delete responses; no portal type declares it.
gaps.risks: No consumer. No portal type declares it.
gaps.details: Likely a name collision rather than a gap. The bare name appears in 12 portal types, but none of them is the Ballerina record this field belongs to. Re-check before implementing.
